zh-CN.title: 更新检查与规则下拉体验优化

sections.title: 更新检查
items: 自动检查新增“客户端启动时”选项，每次启动 Tabby 后检查一次，本次运行期间不再重复检查

sections.title: 抽屉规则
items: 修复输出规则下拉框内容截断时无法查看完整文本的问题，为选中值和下拉选项补充悬停提示
确保规则下拉框中的用户自定义命令名称和分类名称始终保持原文

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。现有命令库和插件设置会保留。

en.title: Update checks and rule dropdown improvements

sections.title: Update checks
items: Add an “On client startup” automatic-check option that checks once after Tabby starts without repeating during the same run

sections.title: Drawer rules
items: Fix truncated output-rule dropdown text by adding full hover tooltips to selected values and menu options
Keep user-defined command and category names unchanged in rule dropdowns

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Existing command libraries and plugin settings are preserved.
